versions.changelog: R20 upgrade 0.2.7: align judgment, evidence and trust boundaries; regression fixes and release checks. Validation limits and remaining issues are documented in the bundled CHANGELOG.md.

First hub release. Writes a NEW, complete, spec-compliant paper from a requirement (word count / citation style / sections) and/or topic. Two integrity invariants: never fabricate citations, never plagiarize — unverifiable sources are marked [SOURCE NEEDED], not invented. Pre-registered disjunctive stop conditions; independent blind-judge rubric with unknown-exit auditing.
